From: Patricia Singh <patricia.singh@stratoslabs.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-21T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Dedicated capacity demo — throughput + latency constraints

Hi Ben,

We signed up via the self-serve flow last week and hit a hard ceiling on latency when we tried a small proof-of-concept. Stratos would like to evaluate Redwood Dedicated for a production rollout. High-level constraints:
- Target steady-state: ~300 requests/sec (QPS) for inference across 10k daily active sessions
- P95 latency budget: <= 100ms for short completion (~128 tokens) — ideally 50ms for critical paths
- Burst tolerance: short spikes to 1k QPS for traffic surges

Our CTO (Ankur) wants a technical deep-dive focused on throughput tuning, batching behavior, and how KV cache/quantization tradeoffs affect p95. Can we schedule a hands-on demo with a solutions engineer for a throughput run? We're in PDT and prefer mornings next week.

I've attached a short PDF with our SLA/latency asks.

Thanks,
Patricia
Patricia Singh
Head of Engineering — Stratos Labs
patricia.singh@stratoslabs.com

Attachment: Stratos_SLA_Reqs.pdf (1 page)

- Capacity: we can run a 60-min throughput test at 1k QPS if we pre-warm a small Dedicated pool and enable burst nodes. That requires a short reservation window and a smoke dry-run to warm KV caches.
- Ops checklist (we'll send as a one-pager before the CTO call): sample payloads (JSON examples), token-length distribution, a small traffic replay, SSH access for logs (if they want deeper tracing), and a signed NDA if they plan to share PII samples.
- Proposed schedule (PDT):
  * May 24, 09:00–09:30 — Exec architecture + Q&A (Ben to join; Karthish optional)
  * May 25, 06:00–07:15 — Throughput run (ops workshop + traffic replay)

I'll attach a short demo plan and will coordinate with infra to reserve nodes for the May 25 dry-run and run. If Stratos can't do 06:00, we can push to 07:00 but the earlier slot minimizes interference with their maintenance.
